config.history_attribute: 揭示后历史研究；不是新盲测或独立OOS
config.distribution_policy: Split shares divide by split_factor; cash distributions remain cash; no fund fee duplication
config.missing_vix_policy: Break low streak; unknown running peak until lifecycle ends; do not infer retreat across gap
config.missing_vx_policy: Skip unjudgeable day, continue original window; first observed signal allowed but first-trigger gap excluded from complete paired evidence
config.missing_price_policy: No interpolation or postponed fill; unknown transaction result remains null; continuous ledger stops before first unvalued date
config.overlap_policy: Skip new entry if entry <= existing planned exit; no queue
config.path_policy: Close-only fixed-share path after entry; MAE/MFE relative to post-buy equity before sale cost; net drawdown also separate
config.period_policy: Events assigned by shock start; trades/opportunities require maturity by period end; continuous slices never reset capital
config.cluster_policy: Connected overlap of [s,s+window+lag+max(horizons)] under main configuration; never feeds signals
config.baseline_policy: Common 2019-01-02 cash anchor; earliest baseline purchase 2019-01-03 close; no forced terminal sale
config.bil_policy: Independent N1 total-return reinvestment proxy, entry 5bp, no terminal forced sale; not SVXY/BIL rotation

scope: E1 only; no M2 fits or old release verification; stop for acceptance; no commit or push
